description:
**Company Description** 





 Wekalp is a Data Intelligence and Automation Platform that enables AI agents to act on reliable, governed enterprise data. Our living semantic layer captures the context of how businesses actually run — and surfaces it as conversational intelligence, automated pipelines, and board\-ready insights. We currently serve BFSI and CPG enterprises, are CERT\-IN certified and provide flexible deployment options across customer, shared, or on\-premise cloud.
 




  





 Key responsibilities
 


* Administer Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes (OKD) clusters — installation, upgrades, operators, ingress, RBAC, networking, and security policies.
* Design and manage AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Route 53\) including IAM, VPC, and security groups.
 
  Wekalp's data and storage layer is platform\-native — this role manages the infrastructure it runs on, not AWS data services
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for containerized microservice and platform deployments.
* Deploy and operate Wekalp's platform in customer\-managed environments — on\-premise data centres and customer clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP tenants) — including air\-gapped setups, private networking constraints, and customer\-specific security policies.
* Own cross\-environment interoperability: ensure consistent platform behaviour, configuration parity, and upgrade paths across Wekalp\-hosted and customer\-hosted deployments.
* Manage AWS Bedrock service integration — API availability, request routing, IAM permission boundaries, and cost monitoring for inference workloads.
* Support deployment and connectivity of MCP servers that we build for enterprise customers integrating with Claude — including networking, auth, and endpoint reliability.
* Ensure observability across platform services: Prometheus, Grafana dashboards covering infra health, API latency, and Bedrock usage metric



**Qualifications** 



* 2–4 years of hands\-on DevOps or platform engineering experience.
* Proficient with Red Hat OpenShift or Kubernetes cluster administration.
* AWS infrastructure experience: EKS, EC2, Route 53, IAM, and VPC. Note: Wekalp's data and storage layer is platform\-native — familiarity with AWS compute and networking is what's needed, not AWS data services
* Experience deploying software into customer\-managed environments — on\-premise or private cloud — including handling restricted networks, custom TLS, and enterprise proxy configurations
* CI/CD pipeline design using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions. Docker and container image lifecycle management.
* Linux administration, cloud networking, and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Prometheus \+ Grafana and ELK/EFK logging stacks.
* Automation using
 **Ansible or scripting (Bash/Python)**
* Working knowledge of AWS Bedrock — how it's invoked, how access is controlled, and how costs are tracked across foundation model API calls.
* Awareness of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — what it does, how servers expose data to AI agents, and how to keep those connections reliable and secure in an enterprise context.
* Cost\-conscious mindset — especially for variable inference workloads on managed AI services.
* Strong troubleshooting instincts and ability to collaborate across data, AI, and product teams

**Standout Qualities**
* Previous internship or part\-time experience in an IT support or helpdesk environment.
* Basic hands\-on exposure to Office 365, Google Workspace, or modern ticketing systems.

 You will join our collaborative, global IT Helpdesk team, working alongside experienced IT professionals who are dedicated to mutual growth. This role offers a supportive environment featuring a core training program and direct mentorship designed to get you up to speed. You will collaborate daily with global team members, cross\-functional partners, and employees worldwide to tackle technical challenges together.

 We operate in a fast\-paced, modern, and tech\-forward environment that prioritizes continuous learning and professional development. What sets this role apart from competitors is the immediate, hands\-on exposure you will get to enterprise\-level infrastructure and cutting\-edge tools.

* Device Management: Jamf (Mac) and Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune (Windows)
* Identity \& Access: Okta
* Productivity Suites: Office 365 and Google Workspace
* Collaboration \& AV: Zoom and modern AV equipment
* Service Management: Enterprise\-level IT service management tools

* 18 calendar days of paid vacation
* 12 days of National \& Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
* Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
* Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12\) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.

* Group Medical Insurance (Employees \+ Dependents)
* Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000\)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000\)

**Who Is Wrike And Our Culture**
 We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
   

  

**Hybrid work mode**
 Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000\+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co\-working spaces across many locations.
   

  

 While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in\-person collaboration and connection.
   

  

**Our persona**
**💡 Smart:** 
 We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
   

  

**💚 Dedicated:** 
 We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
   

  

**🤗 Approachable:** 
 We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.
   

  

**Our culture and Values**
**🤩 Customer\-Focused**
**We care about our customers.** 
 We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision\-making and action\-taking are done with the customer in mind.
   

  

**🤝 Collaborative**
**We work as one and win together,** 
 each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
   

  

**🎨 Creative**

 It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
   

  

**💪 Committed**

title: System Administrator
description:
**About CynLr** 




  





 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to
 **instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Demo Video** 




 Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesn’t exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to
 **assemble a Smartphone** 
 or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment.
 



 CynLr\-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on\-the\-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre\-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO\-like micro\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



 At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



 This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 As a
 *System Administrator at CynLr* 
 , you will design, build, and evolve IT infrastructure, processes, and practices that support research, product development, and operations, while ensuring efficient, secure, and sustainable usage. Process for the sake of process will not be entertained;
 *utility and convenience take precedence, and every system must justify its existence by improving real outcomes.* 





  





 CynLr's ambition demands not only breakthrough algorithms and hardware, but also a
 *robust, adaptive, and human\-centric IT infrastructure* 
 that allows teams to operate with minimal friction and maximum focus. As CynLr scales across disciplines, tools, and geographies,
 *IT infrastructure becomes the information backbone of the organization.* 
 The goal of this role is not merely uptime or compliance, but to
 *augment human productivity* 
 , eliminate hidden delays and context\-switching costs, and ensure that technology remains an enabler rather than a constraint.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***A. Operate***




  




* Run and maintain IT infrastructure supporting research, engineering, and operations at scale.
* Administer the Office 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, identity and access).
* Operate and secure endpoint devices across Windows, Android, BYOD, and corporate assets.
* Manage network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, and VPNs.
* Perform hands\-on monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution across hardware, OS, network, and applications.



  





***B. Build***




  




* Design and deploy Azure AD, Intune, and SharePoint policies for secure and organized access.
* Set up and maintain hardware infrastructure—laptops, workstations, servers, networking, and conferencing systems.
* Configure and support Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware / Hyper\-V).
* Establish remote workflows and inter\-office connectivity to enable distributed teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with hardware, software, and service vendors.



  





***C. Improve***



* Automate workflows and remediation using PowerShell scripting to reduce manual effort.
* Evaluate and select hardware and software based on supportability, ecosystem maturity, scalability, and lifecycle cost.
* Proactively monitor systems, analyse failures, and implement preventive and reliability improvements.

**Job Title: Local Area Network (LAN) Engineer** 




**Department: Network Infrastructure** 




**Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent** 




**Level: Senior / Lead** 




**Min. LAN Experience: 7 Years – Architecture \& Design** 




**Min. Cisco Experience: 5 Years – Routing \& Switching.** 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW:** 




 The Local Area Network Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of the enterprise LAN environment. Reporting directly to the Network Manager, this individual will serve as the primary subject matter expert across LAN infrastructure, Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), routing and switching protocols, and network automation. The role demands a hands\-on engineer with a strong track record of leading complex network projects in multi\-site enterprise environments.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* Lead end\-to\-end architecture and design of enterprise LAN environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security across all sites.
* Deploy, manage, and optimize Cisco Viptela SD\-WAN solutions including policy configuration, template management, and multi\-site orchestration.
* Configure and maintain Cisco switching and routing infrastructure, including OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, VLAN segmentation, STP/RSTP, HSRP, and VRRP.
* Collaborate with the Network Manager and cross\-functional teams to define network strategy and long\-term infrastructure roadmap.
* Conduct network capacity planning, traffic analysis, and performance tuning to consistently meet or exceed defined SLAs.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation including topology diagrams, HLD/LLD designs, runbooks, and change management records.
* Lead root cause analysis for complex network incidents and drive implementation of permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Evaluate and recommend new networking technologies, vendor solutions, and best practices to continuously improve the environment.
* Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing and upskilling initiatives.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical network incidents and planned maintenance activities.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** 




**Experience \& Technical Skills (Must Have):** 



* Minimum 7 years of hands\-on experience in LAN architecture and design within complex, multi\-site enterprise environments.
* Minimum 5 years of direct experience with Cisco networking platforms, specifically enterprise\-grade switching and routing hardware and software.
* Proven, demonstrable expertise with Cisco Viptela SD\-WAN — including design, deployment, vManage policy configuration, and advanced troubleshooting.
* Deep working knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols: VLANs, 802\.1Q, STP/RSTP/MSTP, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP.
* Strong practical experience with Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switching platforms in production environments.
* Proven ability to produce detailed network designs, high\-level designs (HLD), low\-level designs (LLD), and comprehensive solution proposals.
* Solid understanding of network security principles including ACLs, microsegmentation, firewall integration, and Zero Trust concepts.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate and resolve complex, multi\-layer network issues under pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



  





**NICE TO HAVE:** 



* **Cisco Certification:** 
 CCNP Enterprise, CCNP SD\-WAN, or CCIE strongly preferred. Any current and valid Cisco certification will be viewed positively.
* **Cisco DNA Center (DNAC):** 
 Hands\-on experience with Cisco DNAC for intent\-based networking, network assurance, device provisioning, and automated policy management.
* **Python API Integration with Cisco DNAC:** 
 Ability to develop Python\-based scripts and automation workflows leveraging Cisco DNA Center REST APIs for device management, telemetry, and reporting.
* **SolarWinds:** 
 Experience with SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor (NPM) and/or Network Configuration Manager (NCM) for SNMP\-based monitoring, alerting, and configuration compliance.
* **API Integration – SolarWinds \& DNAC via Python:** 
 Ability to build integrated automation pipelines combining SolarWinds and Cisco DNAC APIs using Python to create unified monitoring dashboards, automated incident responses, and cross\-platform reporting.
* **Network Automation Frameworks:** 
 Familiarity with Ansible, Terraform, or NetBox for infrastructure\-as\-code practices and automated network provisioning workflows.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER:** 




**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 




 We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of background, identity, or experience. Applicants must be authorized to work in the applicable jurisdiction without visa sponsorship unless otherwise stated.
 


* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
* Professional development budget with full financial support for Cisco certification exam fees and training.
* Collaborative, engineer\-first culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Flexible hybrid work arrangements with a focus on work\-life balance.
* Access to cutting\-edge network infrastructure, tooling, and lab environments.
* Clear career progression pathways within the Network Infrastructure and broader IT organization.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
 Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
   

  

 Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, and optimization of our global, high\-availability network infrastructure across data centers and AWS cloud environments. Your role involves expert\-level knowledge in managing complex enterprise routing and switching, designing and maintaining enterprise Wireless Infrastructure (Cisco Meraki), configuring enterprise\-grade firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto), and integrating hybrid cloud solutions. * Bachelor’s Degree and 7\+ years of experience in Network Engineering

title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on CRT, you execute capacity restoration workflows across Amazon’s global network. You troubleshoot link and device failures. You coordinate with cross\-functional teams. You drive TTR down for out\-of\-service capacity. This role is focused on operational execution using existing tools and processes. You work at the component level, solving straightforward problems with guidance from your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Execute link restoration workflows for Regional Border and Backbone spans.
* Troubleshoot hardware and software failures on network devices.
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on repairs.
* Monitor capacity health using operational event monitoring systems, network health monitoring systems, and workflow orchestration engines.
* Perform device health checks and link tests to validate restoration.
* Maintain accurate records of restoration progress, backlog status, and TTR metrics.
* Identify patterns in recurring failures and escalate to engineering teams.
* Contribute to operational runbooks and process documentation.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Monitor capacity health dashboards and respond to out\-of\-service alerts
* Troubleshoot hardware/software failures on backbone and border network devices
* Execute restoration workflows using established automation and runbooks
* Coordinate with carriers, colocation providers, and data center technicians on link repairs
* Document incidents and contribute to post\-event reviews
* Participate in on\-call rotations supporting high severity calls and operational events.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
* Experience with IP networking fundamentals and TCP/IP, UDP, DNS \& DHCP
* Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience with network troubleshooting tools (telnet, test\-netconnection, tracert, tracetcp, iperf, ntttcp, dig, and packet capture tools)
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* 3\+ years of experience in network operations or network engineering.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
* Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience in technical support and experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
* 3\+ years of work in large\-scale networking environments experience
* 1\+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience, or experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment
* Experience with mission\-critical, 24x7 operations
* CCNA or equivalent level networking certification

**Job Title: Network Engineer I – Core Network \& F5 (2nd Shift)**
**Job Summary**
 LPL is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Network Engineer to lead and support the core network infrastructure across office locations and data centers. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and load balancing solutions, with a strong emphasis on Cisco technologies and F5 load balancers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and hands\-on experience with network monitoring and performance optimization tools. This position is critical to delivering scalable, resilient, and secure networking solutions that support LPL, our advisors, and their clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deploy, and manage core network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, and WiFi across office and data center environments
* Configure and maintain Cisco routers, switches, Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC), and Nexus platforms.
* Build and manage F5 LTM VIPs, iRule, perform health monitoring, and troubleshoot application delivery issues.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing continuous improvement of the environment
* Effectively collaborate with various Teams within the organization as well as external vendors and partners to support business needs and ensure network scalability and reliability.

* Document network diagram, configurations, and operational procedures.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Proven expertise in F5 LTM configuration and troubleshooting.
* Experience with SD\-WAN solutions and wireless network design.
* Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead network initiatives.


**Core Competencies**
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), and VLANs.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.
* Effective collaboration with internal teams and external vendors.
* Commitment to documentation and process improvement.
* Solid knowledge and experience in well\-known protocols and standards (i.e. VLANs, Spanning\-Tree, OSPF, BGP, HSRPDNS, 802\.1x)


**Preferred Technologies \& Tools**
* Networking: Cisco Routers, Switches, WLC, Nexus, SD\-WAN
* Load Balancing: F5 LTM
* Monitoring \& Diagnostics: SolarWinds, Cisco DNA Center, ThousandEyes, ExtraHop, LiveWire

title: Network Engineer, Capacity Restoration Team
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 As a Network Engineer on the Capacity Restoration Team, you bring experience and autonomy to own end\-to\-end capacity restoration for assigned network segments. You drive complex troubleshooting across multiple failure domains, mentor engineers, define and improve operational processes, and partner with engineering teams to address systemic resilience gaps. You apply correct technologies and best practices to complex problems, and your scope of influence spans the full team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Execution**
* Own capacity restoration outcomes for assigned network segments, driving TTR reduction and backlog elimination.
* Lead complex, multi\-party troubleshooting for link and device failures spanning carriers, colocations, and internal teams.
* Participate in war rooms for critical events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.
* Participate in on\-call rotations for follow\-the\-sun coverage.


**Process And Operations Improvement**
* Define and improve operational processes and runbooks for restoration workflows.
* Analyze restoration metrics (TTR, backlog depth, network health score impact) to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Drive vendor accountability for carrier and colocation\-related restoration delays.


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Partner with Topology Engineering, Capacity Engineering, and fabric engineering teams to address systemic issues.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.


**Mentorship And Development**
* Mentor and develop Network Engineers, providing technical guidance and review.
* Contribute to hiring loops and technical assessments.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Lead complex capacity restoration events involving multiple network layers and cross\-region links.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and develop remediation plans for recurring failures.
* Improve operational processes, runbooks, and escalation procedures based on observed patterns.
* Mentor engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams on platform readiness and design validation.
* Drive vendor and carrier accountability for restoration delays.
* Represent Capacity Restoration Team in cross\-organizational reviews and operational planning.
* Participate in war rooms for major events breaching container or region SLA thresholds.


**About The Team**
 The Capacity Restoration Team (CRT) sits within Backbone, Enterprise, Regional Engineering (BERE) organization. Our mission is to own end\-to\-end restoration of out\-of\-service inter\-metro and intra\-metro network capacity.
   

  

 CRT reduces operational backlog, improves network health monitoring systems, and drives time\-to\-remediate (TTR) down. Today, a significant network capacity is out of service at any given time. The operational workload is capacity related and heavily manual and we are building the team and automation to change that.
   

  

 We operate across Seattle, Dublin, Hyderabad, and Sydney for follow\-the\-sun coverage. CRT acts as the connective layer between Engineering, Operations, Tooling, and Software teams.
   

  

**About Aws**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amaze Con (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience driving improvement programs in the operations, engineering and support fields
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
* 5\+ years of computer networking experience
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience with BGP, OSPF, or IS\-IS in large\-scale network environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in managing critical operational processes, with SLA responsibility
* Experience mentoring or training the engineering community on complex technical issues
* 1\+ years of fiber handling and fiber installation processes experience, or experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment \& troubleshooting methodologies
* CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with network performance analysis (TCP tuning, ECMP, traffic engineering).
* Experience with carrier coordination and maintenance management.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
We're building the future of hybrid work at peopleHum and we need an Associate PM who's obsessed with quality, accountability, and shipping great product. You'll report to the Head of Product, drive roadmap execution, spend serious time with customers, and own features end\-to\-end — from PRD to UAT to production. We're actively building in the AI and Agentic space, so a genuine curiosity for AI tools and workflows is non\-negotiable.
   

  

 W H A T Y O U ' L L D O
   

  

* Report to and collaborate with the Head of Product to develop strategies that expand peopleHum into new markets, positioning it as a leading HCM platform for the hybrid work model.
* Drive roadmap execution to rapidly expand the product suite and create sustainable product differentiation — moving fast without cutting quality corners.
* Spend a disproportionate amount of time with customers and prospects — informing product vision, co\- innovating on solutions, and bringing the outside\-in perspective to every roadmap decision.
* Define your features completely — write PRDs, specs, and user stories with full ownership of your modules. Engineers should be able to build from your documents without constant back\-and\-forth.
* Manage daily workflow with a team of engineers and designers, unblocking sprint ceremonies and enabling clear decision\-making.
* Own UAT before every production release — write test cases, catch regressions and edge cases, and sign off on quality. You are the last line of defence before customers see the product. MUST HAVE
* Analyse the effectiveness of shipped features — track usage, identify failure points, and define iterative improvements to reduce drop\-offs and increase adoption.
* Own every task assigned to you — follow through without reminders, communicate blockers early, and close the loop with stakeholders.
* Represent your team in communication with product, engineering, design, and marketing leadership — be a clear, structured voice for your squad.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* MBA is a plus, particularly if paired with strong technical depth.


 Must have skills
   

  

* 1–3 years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment — you understand enterprise workflows, multi\-stakeholder selling, and longer feedback cycles.
* A quality\-obsessed mindset — you've personally run UATs, written test cases, and taken accountability for what ships to production.
* Passion for building delightful products with an eye for design — you have intuition for good user flows, UX detail, and can articulate what 'well\-crafted' means.
* Demonstrated accountability and ownership: you close tasks, not just open them. You flag risks early and follow up proactively.
* Strong prioritization instincts — you can triage a messy backlog, say no clearly, and explain tradeoffs to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulation of customer problems — vague specs are not acceptable.
* Technical fluency — ability to gain an in\-depth understanding of software systems, work comfortably with engineers on architecture discussions, and make meaningful technical contributions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools daily — Cursor, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Notion AI, or similar — and a genuine curiosity for how these tools work.
* Working understanding of LLM\-based products — prompt design, RAG architectures, AI agents, and the failure modes unique to AI systems (hallucinations, latency, eval metrics).


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Understanding of the HCM (human capital management) space and enterprise SaaS — highly desirable but not a blocker if everything else fits.
* Experience with tools like JIRA, Linear, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, and Notion.
* Exposure to API\-first or developer\-facing B2B products.
* Basic SQL or data querying ability to self\-serve on product analytics.
* Prior experience shipping features that included an AI or ML component.

*is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. *The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




  

  





*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




  

  





*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*




  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Basic Function and Scope of Responsibility:**
  

 The IT Business Analyst supports the organization by assessing the impact of requested changes, capturing and documenting requirements, and ensuring that those requirements are delivered by IT. In addition, the Business Analyst is responsible for the documentation and execution of test plans for the delivered functionality while supporting the business through the implementation process. Business Analysis is part of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and the Business Analyst will be involved from initial concept through final implementation, including requirements gathering, design, testing and implementation.
   

  

  

  

**Essential Job Duties:
   

  

 Level I \- Minimum**



* Consult with different areas of the organization to identify and document the requirements for new systems and enhancements to existing systems.

* Track and document requirements for business and functional specifications using best practice standards developed by the Business Analysis team.
* Track and fully document test cases to validate requirements are met using best practice standards developed by the Business Analysis team.
* Participate in direct observations with business resources to understand workflows as part of the project timeline.The Business Analyst will need to be able to execute workflows during testing phases of the project.
* Actively participate in testing of new and enhanced system functionality.
* Capture issues found in testing in a documentation repository.
* Document requirements, test cases, issues,and testing evidence using a documentation repository.
* Understand and follow the Information Technology (IT) SDLC process.
* Represent department and the organization favorably and in accordance with established Company standards and associate attributes at all times
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned by management



  

  

  

  

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
   

  

 Level I \- Minimum**



* BS degree in biological, physical, chemical, clinical laboratory science or an associate degree in medical laboratory technology and/or equivalent work experience.
* 1\-2 years of professional work experience.
* Understanding of lab operations and functions.
* Ability to use Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy of information.
* Strong verbal \&written communication skills.
* Service driven with a professional attitude.
* Ability to solve problems, prioritize and multi\-task in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Self\-motivated with ability to work independently and within a team.
* Ability to make independent decisions on small issues seeking guidance from management when necessary.
* Goal\-oriented, with excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills,with ability to interact effectively and work efficiently with peers.
* Ability to keep sensitive information confidential.
* Healthcare or laboratory knowledge/experience preferred.


****Additional Information****

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



**PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA** 
 : Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half\-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

 Knowledge Content Development

title: Business Analyst
description:
**This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Business Analyst in India.**
 This role sits at the heart of commercial decision\-making for a fast\-scaling digital telco environment, where data is central to shaping growth, pricing, and customer experience strategies. You will transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that guide decisions across acquisition, monetization, and product performance. Working closely with commercial, product, marketing, and finance teams, you will help define and track key KPIs while uncovering opportunities to improve business outcomes. The position requires a strong analytical mindset combined with business acumen to support strategic and operational initiatives. You will also play a key role in shaping reporting frameworks and decision\-support tools used by leadership teams. This is a high\-impact role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, strategy, and execution in fast\-moving digital markets.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 You will be responsible for driving data\-driven decision\-making by analyzing commercial performance, supporting strategic initiatives, and enabling better business execution across key growth areas.
   

  

* Track and analyze core commercial KPIs to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities across acquisition, pricing, and usage funnels
* Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to commercial, product, and marketing teams to improve performance
* Own recurring reporting cycles for leadership, ensuring clear storytelling and data\-driven narratives
* Support ad hoc analysis requests, campaign performance deep\-dives, and data tracking setup
* Conduct pricing, bundling, and monetization analyses including scenario modeling and sensitivity testing
* Assist in aligning forecasts, business planning, and revenue assumptions with commercial and finance stakeholders
* Support go\-to\-market initiatives, product launches, and experimentation frameworks with analytical input
* Build and improve measurement systems to accelerate learning cycles and improve decision\-making quality


**Requirements**
 You are a highly analytical and business\-oriented professional with strong data skills and the ability to translate insights into impactful commercial decisions.
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in business analysis, commercial strategy, or growth analytics roles in B2C digital industries
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel, with experience using BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
* Solid understanding of commercial metrics, ideally within telco, fintech, or e\-commerce environments
* Ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into clear business recommendations
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders
* Experience with pricing, revenue analysis, or growth optimization is highly desirable
* Familiarity with emerging or fast\-growing digital markets (MENA experience is a plus)
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with attention to detail and structured thinking


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing digital telco and SaaS ecosystem
* Exposure to high\-impact commercial, pricing, and growth strategy initiatives
* Collaboration with cross\-functional global teams across product, marketing, and finance

* Career growth opportunities in a rapidly scaling international organization

**Summary**
 As a 3rd Level Network Systems Engineer (m/f/d), you are responsible for designing, implementing, and operating secure, scalable, and globally standardized network services across the enterprise. You ensure the reliability and security of LAN, WiFi, and IPsec connectivity for warehouses, distribution centers, and branch offices across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
**About Turing:** 




 Turing is one of the world’s fastest\-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 



 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real\-world AI systems that solve mission\-critical priorities for companies.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine\-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future\-proof your career in an AI\-first world!
 



  





 Your role is critical in helping fine\-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future\-proof your career in an AI\-first world!
 



  





**What does day\-to\-day look like:** 



* You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer \& explanation to enable the models to learn:
* Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
* **In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods:** 
 Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?



  





**Note:** 
 No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.
 



  





**Requirements:** 



* **English Proficiency:** 
 Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Good research and analytical skills
* **Feedback Skills:** 
 Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
* **Creative Thinking:** 
 Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
* **Communication:** 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* **Independence:** 
 Self\-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
* **Technical Setup:** 
 Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
* Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
* Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
* Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.



  





**Perks of Freelancing With Turing:** 



* Work in a fully remote environment.
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
* Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.



  





**After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.**

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst** 




**Location:** 

 Hyderabad (Hybrid Work Model)                                                     
 




**Experience:** 

 4 to 7 years
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-Time
   






**About the Role** 




 We are not looking for someone who just documents requirements. We want someone who can walk into a client room, earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and translate messy business problems into clear, actionable specs \- then stay close to the team until it ships
 *.* 




**What you will do:** 




 ·      Own client discovery end\-to\-end — lead requirement gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews independently
 



 ·      Translate business needs into detailed functional specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria the dev team can act on immediately
 



 ·      Be the primary bridge between client and engineering — maintain clarity, flag scope creep, and keep everyone aligned
 



 ·      Drive sprint ceremonies alongside the PM/TL — refinement, planning, demos — and keep the backlog healthy
 



 ·      Proactively identify gaps, risks, and dependencies before they become problems
 



 ·      Use AI tools actively to accelerate research, documentation, and analysis — and help the team adopt them too
 



 ·      Build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders at all levels — from ops to leadership
 



**What you bring:** 




 ·      4–7 years as a BA in a software product or services environment — ideally working directly with international clients
 



 ·      Strong technical foundation — you understand APIs, data flows, system integrations, and can read a user story with a dev's eye
 



 ·      Excellent communication — sharp written skills, confident in client meetings, clear under ambiguity
 



 ·      Proven ability to work without hand\-holding — you drive the process, you don't wait to be asked
 



 ·      Comfortable in fast\-moving agile teams — context switches quickly, priorities shift, and that doesn't unsettle you
 



 ·      A natural curiosity — you ask "why" before "what", and you question assumptions others have stopped questioning
 



  





**Must Have:** 




 • Jira / Confluence
 



 • User Story creation and management
 



 • BRD / FRD documentation
 



 • SQL basics
 



 • API concepts
 



 • Agile / Scrum methodology
 



 • Wireframing
 



**Good to Have:** 




 • Figma
 



 • Postman
 



 • Data Modelling
 



 • TestRail
 



 • Miro
 



 • Process Mapping
 



  





**AI fluency — non\-negotiable:** 




 ·      Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in day\-to\-day work — not occasionally, habitually
 



 ·      Can use AI to draft specs, summarize meetings, generate test scenarios, and research domain context faster
 



 ·      Thinks about where AI can reduce friction in the client–dev loop and experiments with it
 



 ·      Stays current — knows what's new, tries things, brings ideas back to the team
 



**What makes you stand out:** 




 ·      You've worked on SaaS products or complex enterprise software — you know what "production\-ready" means
 



 ·      You've managed clients across time zones without losing quality or trust
 



 ·      You've pushed back on a client (diplomatically) and were right — and they respected it
 



 ·      You have opinions about what good requirements look like — and you can defend them
 



  





 Please share your resumes to hr@techgrit.com

description:

 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide.  As an Application Consultant specializing in Edge \& Network Cloud, you will utilize your applied knowledge of fundamental concepts and technologies associated with Telecom Network, Software Defined Network/NFV to deliver solutions.  Master's Degree

* Virtual Network Functions: Familiarity with various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) and their implementation in telecom networks.
* OSS System Integration: Experience working with the integration of ALM, ASM, NOI with other OSS systems, depending on the solution scope.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Telecom Network Architecture: Exposure to designing and implementing telecom network architectures, including Software Defined Network and NFV, to support solution delivery.
* Advanced ALM and ASM: Experience with advanced implementation and configuration of ALM and ASM, including integration with other OSS systems.
* Virtual Network Functionality: Familiarity with implementing and configuring various virtual network functions from Network Equipment Providers (NEPs) in telecom networks.

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 Building for Scale, Rapid Iterative Development, and Customer\-centric Product Thinking at each step defines every day for a developer at PhonePe. * The Economics Institute was launched in 2020 to analyze economic trends through the lens of the consumer to deliver tailored and actionable insights on economic issues for customers, partners and policymakers
* The Institute is composed of a team of economists and data scientists that utilize \& synthesize the anonymized and aggregated data from the Mastercard network together with public data to bring powerful insights to life, in the form of 1:1 presentations, global thought leadership, media participation, and commercial work through the company’s product suites


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an R programmer to join Mastercard’s Economics Institute, reporting to the team lead for Data Systems Engineering. An individual who will:
   

  

* create clear, compelling data visualisations that communicate economic insights to diverse audiences
* develop reusable R functions and packages to support analysis and automation
* create and format analytical content using R Markdown and/or Quarto
* design and build scalable Shiny apps
* develop interactive visualisations using JavaScript charting libraries (e.g. Plotly, Highcharts, D3\.js) or front\-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, Vue.js)work with databases and data platforms (eg. SQL, Hadoop)
* write clear, well\-documented code that others can understand and maintain
* collaborate using Git for version control


**All About You**
* proficient in R and the RStudio IDE or Positron IDE
* proficient in R packages like dplyr for data cleaning, transformation, and aggregation
* familiarity with dependency management and documentation in R (e.g. roxygen2\)
* familiar with version control concepts and tools (e.g. Git, GitHub, Bitbucket) for collaborative development
* experience writing SQL and working with relational databases
* creative and passionate about data, coding, and technology
* strong collaborator who can also work independently organized and able to prioritise work across multiple projects comfortable working with engineers, product owners, data scientists, economists


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
 In Microsoft’s CoreAI division, the Azure SRE Agent Platform team builds and runs ‘AI Agents as Service’ that help Microsoft customers detect, diagnose, and mitigate any production issues across customer’s services \& workloads running on Microsoft platforms. Think of these agents as “virtual SRE teammates” that continuously watch your systems, investigate problems, and recommends or performs fixes, with a focus on quality, safety, security, enterprise scale and real\-world impact.
   

  

 Our work spans the full lifecycle of agentic systems in production. We design and improve the core capabilities that shape agent behavior, including tool design, planning and execution loops, orchestration, evaluation, and safety guardrails. We build the operational foundations that make those systems dependable in practice, including observability, progressive delivery, reliability engineering, and live\-site learning. And we build the best user experience for our customers to use these agents from any device seamlessly.
   

  

 We are looking for a full stack Software Engineer II teammate to help build this next generation of agentic systems for cloud operations. This role is for engineers who care deeply about product quality, end\-to\-end ownership, and the details that separate an exciting prototype from a system people trust during critical moments.
   

  

 Engineers on our team operate with high autonomy in a highly agile environment: short cycles, thin slices, feature flags, progressive delivery, and constant learning. We are looking for teammates with strong owner’s mindset and a strong bias for action \- engineers who take ownership of ambiguous problems, adopt modern science research, engineering patterns \& practices, move quickly, learn from production, and continuously raise the quality bar as they ship.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Take ownership of important areas of the Azure SRE Agent Platform, including agent capabilities, orchestration, evaluation, user experiences on different form factors and supporting platform services
* Build and iterate on agentic systems, including tools, planning and execution loops, evaluations, and safety mechanisms
* Design and ship reliable capabilities that improve incident detection, diagnosis, mitigation, and operational learning
* Use telemetry, experiments, evaluations, and user feedback to guide iteration and investment
* Contribute to resilient, observable systems that operate safely and effectively in production
* Partner closely with engineers, SREs, and product counterparts to turn ambiguous problems into high\-quality shipped solutions
* Participate in debugging, live\-site learning, and post\-incident hardening to continuously improve system quality
* Contribute to architecture, engineering standards, and development practices across the team


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+  years of experience building production software using one or more modern programming languages such as C\#, C\+\+, Go, Java or Python.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI \& software engineering fundamentals, data structures, and problem\-solving.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to deliver customer and business impact.


**Other Requirements**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience of building and operating LLM powered agentic systems in production, with direct ownership over quality, reliability, and iterations
* 3\+ years of experience building and operating cloud platforms or distributed services, with depth in service architecture, deployment, and observability
* Strong product mindset with a track record of owning ambiguous problem spaces and driving them to high\-quality outcomes
* Solid engineering fundamentals, including systems design, performance, and debugging in complex production environments
* Track record of designing, running, and optimizing evaluations for agentic systems, including tools, prompts, and agent loops
* Expertise with Kubernetes, container orchestration, or cloud\-native infrastructure is a strong plus
* Experience contributing to or leading open\-source projects at scale is a plus

* The candidate should be comfortable working in complex, distributed environments and contribute to building reliable, scalable, and cloud‑ready backup and restore solutions for Teradata’s platforms.


 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Development of new complex features, enabling backup/recovery and disaster recovery as part of Data Protection Platform solutions
* Understand the existing features and code which needs strong ‘C/C\+\+’ skills and data structures.
* Contribute to design, development and maintenance phases of the product’s lifecycle
* Collaborate with teams and product partners distributed across the globe
* Provide technical assistance, and enable the product’s customers, located in various geographical regions


**Who You’ll Work With**
* Our team is composed of engineers specializing in backup and restore technologies, core platform integration, debugging, test automation and validation, and automated OS/cloud image delivery.
* Together, we focus on delivering comprehensive, reliable, and scalable data protection solutions for the Teradata SQL Engine across all supported environments, On‑Premises, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
* We are seeking a candidate to join our fast‑paced, innovative development organization that plays a key role in advancing Teradata’s “Teradata Everywhere” and Data Protection Platform (DPP) strategy.

* Master’s/Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar degree, or comparable work experience
* 2\+ years of relevant experience, preferably in R\&D based teams
* Strong C/C\+\+ programming skills
* Strong knowledge of object\-oriented programming concepts and principles
* Deep understanding of data structures coupled with ability to write algorithms
* Excellent problem solving and strong debugging skills
* Exposure to RDBMS and ability to understand complex database features
* Familiarity with public cloud environments and platforms like AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
* Experience with Python, Perl, Shell, etc.
* Experience with code versioning tools and defect tracking tools such as Git and Jira.
* Experience in working in UNIX / Linux environments
* A passion for innovation and continuous learning, with the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to produce technical documents


**What You’ll Bring**
* B Tech / M Tech / MCA in Computer Science with 2\+ years of development experience in C/C\+\+.
* Understanding of backup/restore workflows, snapshotting, data movement, replication, disaster recovery (DR), and storage systems.
* Familiarity with AWS/Azure/GCP or any other public cloud environments.
* Knowledge of professional software engineering practices \& best practices in software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.

description:
**Full\-Stack Engineer (React, Vite \& TanStack Ecosystem)** 




  





**Location: Hybrid/Remote options available**

**About the Role** 




 We are building cutting\-edge AI products that power next\-generation experiences in sports and entertainment. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about creating scalable, high\-performance applications. You’ll work individually initially but with clear pathways to grow into a leadership role, guiding and mentoring future team members. We provide a collaborative environment where you can use AI assistants (like Copilot or Google Code Assist) to do the heavy lifting, allowing you to focus on solid, clean engineering.
 



 What You Will Do
 


* Explore \& Build: Scaffold out new product features and user flows using TypeScript, Vite, and the TanStack ecosystem (Router, Query, and TanStack Start).
* Creative Prototyping: Collaborate with our design team to turn wireframes into functional frontend demos using modern tools like shadcn/ui, Tailwind, or Mantine.
* Connect Features: Wire up frontend interfaces to flexible backends. Over time, you will help us implement interactive features like streaming chatbot components (via WebSockets/SSE) or setting up login flows (SSO).
* Work Smarter, Not Harder: Use AI tools inside VS Code to automate boilerplate, write tests, and spin up mock data models so you can turn around demos cleanly without feeling burnt out.



 What We Look For (The Essentials)
 


* Solid React \& TypeScript Basics: You understand how React works under the hood, and you write clean, structured code that doesn’t turn into unmaintainable spaghetti. Around 3\+ years of experience is great, but solid fundamentals matter most.
* Excitement for TanStack: You love tools like React Query or TanStack Router and are genuinely excited to learn and adopt TanStack Start.
* An AI\-Native Workflow: You enjoy using tools like GitHub Copilot or Google Code Assist to accelerate your development speed while keeping a close eye on data handling and code quality.
* A Flexible, Curious Mindset: You are willing to pick up new concepts as they arise, whether that means tweaking a lightweight Python/FastAPI route, hooking into an AWS Lambda, or configuring an auth provider.



 What This Role is NOT
 


* When we say "high velocity," we mean we use modern AI tools to skip the tedious setup so we can see ideas come to life quickly. We value a sustainable pace, learning, and data accuracy over midnight crunches.
* You won't be trapped writing documentation for weeks. You will be building, experimenting, and seeing your code in action immediately.



 What We Offer
 


* Opportunity to work on AI\-driven products shaping the future of sports and entertainment.
* A culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Growth path into technical leadership roles.
* Flexible work environment and competitive compensation.

description:
Experience: 0 to 2 years (final\-year students, fresh grads, or early\-career frontend engineers welcome)
 





 Location: Mumbai only, Corporate Chamber 1085, Hotel Sahara Star, Vile Parle
 





 Salary: Competitive stipend during internship with conversion to full\-time based on performance
 





 Expected Notice Period: Immediate
 





 Shift: GMT\+05:30 Asia/Kolkata IST
 





 Opportunity Type: In\-office Mumbai (mandatory, no hybrid or remote)
 





 Placement Type: Full Time Internship (with strong intent to convert to permanent)
 





 What do you need for this opportunity?
 





 Must have skills required:
 




  






 Figma fluency (reading, building, and iterating on screens, not just viewing)
 





 Translating Figma designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive frontend code
 





 React (hooks, state management, component architecture)
 





 Next.js or equivalent modern frontend framework
 





 HTML, CSS, and Tailwind (or equivalent utility\-first styling)
 





 TypeScript or strong JavaScript fundamentals
 





 REST API integration (auth headers, error handling, loading and empty states)
 





 Working knowledge of how to read backend API contracts and wire them up correctly
 





 Git and version control fluency (clean commits, useful PRs, no broken main)
 





 An obsession with shipping things that work exactly as expected
 




  






 Renate is Looking for:
 





 Frontend Engineer Intern
 





 The Role
 





 As Frontend Engineer Intern at Renate, you build the product end\-to\-end on the frontend. This is not a "convert mocks to code" seat. You will design screens in Figma, build them in code, wire them to live backend APIs, and ship features that real clients use the same week you ship them. You own the screen from idea to production, including making sure every API call, edge case, loading state, and error state actually works. You report directly to the founder.
 





 Your Impact
 




  






 Build and iterate on Figma screens for new features alongside the product and founder
 





 Translate those screens into pixel\-accurate, responsive, production\-ready frontend code
 





 Wire up backend APIs end\-to\-end, including auth, headers, loading states, error states, and empty states
 





 Catch and handle every edge case before the user does, so features behave exactly as expected
 





 Ship features to production through proper Git workflows, with clean commits and reviewable PRs
 





 Collaborate with backend and AI engineers to align on API contracts, data shapes, and timelines
 





 Maintain frontend code quality, performance, and accessibility as the product scales
 





 Feed UX and product signals back to the team so the next iteration is sharper than the last
 




  






 What You Bring
 




  






 Genuine end\-to\-end ability, where you have built and shipped something real that you can demo, not just completed tutorials
 





 Comfort moving fluidly between Figma and code, without needing a designer to hand\-hold the visual side
 





 Working understanding of React, Next.js (or equivalent), and modern frontend tooling
 





 Confidence integrating REST APIs and handling real\-world failure modes
 





 A high\-taste eye for UI quality, spacing, typography, and interaction polish
 





 High ownership, high speed, and comfort with ambiguity
 





 Ability to track your own work and ship without being chased
 





 Mumbai\-based or willing to relocate immediately
 




  






 Nice to Have
 




  






 A portfolio, personal site, or shipped project that demonstrates both design and engineering chops
 





 Exposure to component libraries like shadcn/ui, Radix, or Chakra
 





 Familiarity with animation libraries (Framer Motion) and micro\-interaction design
 





 Experience working with tRPC, GraphQL, or typed API clients
 





 Understanding of recruitment, HR tech, or B2B SaaS UX patterns
 





 Prior internship, freelance, or hackathon work where you shipped to real users
 




  






 About Renate
 



* Renate is an AI recruitment system. Companies and staffing agencies source candidates through their existing channels, and Renate takes over everything after that, screens every applicant, interviews top candidates via live adaptive phone calls in 13 languages, delivers ranked shortlists with structured scorecards, and supports clients through final\-round interviews. The product is live and pilot clients are already onboarded. We are an 8\-person team in Mumbai, shipped v1 in 6 weeks, and are scaling distribution across India and MENA. US competitors have validated this market with $60M\+ in funding but haven't entered the region. We have.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**Back End Developer** 




 RocketPay (Absird Financial Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) \| HSR Layout, Bengaluru (On\-site)
 



  





**About RocketPay** 




 We started in 2022 because the collections layer in India was broken. Lenders found out about defaults too late. Distributors waited months to know if a retailer would pay. Businesses had no compliant way to collect what was owed. Everyone was building at the transaction layer — nobody was going deeper into what happened after credit was given.
 



  





 We decided to build that infrastructure. Today, RocketPay sits between payment initiation and default — preventing losses before they happen, not cleaning them up after. We are not a payment gateway, and we are not a debt recovery platform. We are the pipe through which credit collections and recovery flows.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll join our shared backend/platform team, building and maintaining services that power both SuperKey and Mandate. Expect to own features end\-to\-end — from API design to deployment — across payments flows, partner integrations, internal tooling, and reconciliation systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and maintain backend services in Java / Spring Boot
* Build and integrate APIs with payment partners and device security partners
* Own reliability, observability, and performance of services handling financial transactions
* Write clean, tested, production\-grade code; participate in code reviews
* Debug production issues across the stack; contribute to recon, settlement, and dispute workflows
* Collaborate directly with founders, ops, and product on fast\-turnaround builds



  





**Requirements** 



* 1 year of backend engineering experience
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot
* Prior startup experience is preffered — comfort with ambiguity, ownership, and shipping fast
* Solid fundamentals: REST API design, relational databases (MySQL / PostgreSQL), version control (Git)
* Ability to debug production issues and reason about distributed systems
* On\-site availability at our HSR Layout, Bengaluru office



  





**Good to Have** 



* Exposure to payments, UPI, NACH, or fintech APIs
* Experience with AWS / GCP, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Kafka, Redis, or message queues
* Open\-source contributions or side projects



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Direct ownership of systems used by thousands of retailers across India
* Close collaboration with founders and senior engineers
* Fast feedback loops — what you build ships within days, not quarters



  





**To Apply:** 
 Send your resume and GitHub / portfolio to divyam@rocketpay.co.in
